The My Driving Style App requires access to your device's GPS to accurately analyze your driving behavior and to provide key features such as challenges, driver analytics, and other gamification elements. This data is essential for ensuring the app functions as intended. Without location permission, these features cannot be enabled, and the app will not be usable.

To proceed, please grant the permission by following the click path:

Open Settings > Permissions > Location > Allow all the time > Return to App

The My Driving Style App requires permission to notifications in order to keep you informed about important updates, relevant changes, and exclusive offerings. Enabling notifications ensures that the My Driving Style App works as intended and that you don’t miss out on key information related to your driving analytics and app features. Without this permission, you may not receive essential alerts.

To proceed, please grant the permission by following the click path:

Grant Permission > Allow

Build an unbroken streak of urban minutes (below speed limit) with zero hard-acceleration events.

Drive in urban speed (below the limit) without hard acceleration.
Each clean minute below the speed limit adds to your streak.
A hard-acceleration event resets the streak to zero — keep rebuilding!
The streak carries over across trips.
Build an unbroken streak of %1$d highway minutes (above 80 km/h) with zero hard-driving events.

Drive at highway speed (80 km/h or above) without any driving events.
Each clean minute at highway speed adds to your streak.
Any driving event at highway speed ends the challenge immediately.
Events below highway speed are neutral — the streak is paused, not broken.
The streak carries over across trips.

Trips do not need to be consecutive.
There are no time-of-day or weekday restrictions.
A single long trip counts once, regardless of how far it exceeds the duration requirement.
Trips below the score or duration threshold are silently ignored — no reset.
Build a streak of %1$d consecutive morning trips (05:00–10:00) each scoring at least 80.

Drive between 05:00 and 10:00 (trip start time counts).
Each morning trip scoring at least 80 advances your streak.
One morning trip scoring below 80 ends the challenge immediately.
Multiple qualifying trips on the same day each count.
A gap of one or more days does not break the streak.
Trips outside the time window are silently ignored.

Drive between 05:00 and 10:00 (trip start time counts).
Each morning trip scoring at least 95 advances your streak.
One morning trip scoring below 95 resets the streak and ends the challenge immediately.
Multiple qualifying trips on the same day each count.
A gap of one or more days does not break the streak.
Trips outside the time window are silently ignored.
No minimum trip duration or distance required.
Complete %1$d perfect-score trips (100 points) in a single calendar day.

Drive %1$d trips with a perfect score (100 points) within a single calendar day.
A score of 100 is only produced when no harsh braking, acceleration, cornering, or seatbelt occurrences are recorded on the trip.
Daily progress resets at the day boundary; the best daily result reached remains available for the progress view.
There is no time-of-day or weekday restriction.

Drive calmly during weekday rush hour.
Complete 3 qualifying trips starting between 06:30–09:00 AND 3 qualifying trips starting between 16:00–18:30 (trip start time counts).
Only Monday–Friday trips qualify; weekend trips are ignored and public holidays count as normal weekdays.
The morning and afternoon counters are tracked separately — extra trips in one window do not make up for a shortfall in the other.
Trips do not need to be consecutive, and there is no minimum trip duration or distance.
Complete 10 trips without hard braking or hard acceleration.
Complete 10 trips without hard or severe braking or acceleration events.\nTrips containing a braking or acceleration event do not count, but they do not fail or reset the challenge.
Achieve %1$d consecutive trips, each with a score of at least %2$d.
Complete %1$d consecutive trips with a score of at least %2$d (a score of exactly %2$d counts).\nOne trip below the threshold resets the streak to zero and fails the challenge.
Achieve a monthly score of at least %1$d for the season month.
Maintain an average score of at least %1$d across all finished trips during the season month. The final monthly score is evaluated when the September season closes.
Complete at least one trip scoring %1$d or higher on every school day.

From the day you start, complete at least one trip scoring %1$d or higher every Monday through Friday through the end of September. One qualifying trip satisfies the day; additional trips cannot undo it. The challenge can be started only during the first seven calendar days of September.
Complete %1$d qualifying trips without severe events during the holiday window.

Complete %1$d qualifying trips from December 20 through December 26. Trips containing severe braking or acceleration events do not count, but they do not fail or reset the challenge. The challenge can be started from the beginning of the December season through December 26.
Improve your January monthly score compared with your previous active month.
Improve your January average score over December. If December has no trips, your January score is compared with your last active month. If you have no previous active month, reach a score above %1$d.

Complete %1$d event-free trips that start on Saturday or Sunday before Monday midnight. Trips with any recorded event do not count, but they do not reset your progress. Each level expires after its seven-day window.
Complete %1$d trips with a score of 80 or higher during the week.
Complete %1$d trips with a score of 80 or higher during the week. Lower scores do not fail your challenge.
Finish %1$d trips with a score of 80 or higher during the month.
Complete %1$d trips this month with a score of 80 or more. Trips below the threshold simply do not count.
